steps.text: We sit down. Your goals, your week, any injury, and a short health questionnaire. If it asks for your GP's go-ahead, we wait for it.
How you move: squat, hinge, reach, balance. Nothing heavy.
A first session, lighter than you expect.
The plan for the month, written down. It reaches you on WhatsApp that day.

firstMonth.message: Hello, I'd like to reserve a first session:

items.name: One to one
items.text: Strength, fitness and mobility, planned around your week and any injury. In the studio or at your home.

items.name: With one other person
items.text: Train with a partner or a friend. One plan for two, priced for the hour, not each.

items.name: First session
items.text: A talk, a health questionnaire and a movement check before any training. Every new client starts here.

qualifications.registerName: My entry on the CIMSPA directory

questions.a: Yes. We talk first, you fill in a short health questionnaire, and I check how you move before any training. If the questionnaire asks for your GP's go-ahead, we wait for it.

questions.q: I haven't trained for years. Is that all right?
questions.a: Most people I train start that way. The first sessions are lighter than you'd expect.
Session by session, after each one, by bank transfer or card. There is no contract.

questions.q: What if I need to cancel?
questions.a: Cancel 24 hours ahead and there's no charge. Later than that, the session counts.

questions.q: Do you come to my home?
questions.a: Yes, in SW1X, SW3, SW7, SW10 and W8. I bring the equipment; a space the size of a mat is enough.

questions.q: How soon will I see a difference?
questions.a: It depends on you, your week and how often we train. I won't promise a number; we'll agree what to look for and check it every four weeks.
Pay-by-phone bays on the King's Road and the streets around it. The yard itself has no parking.

steps: Leave the station and turn onto the King's Road
Walk west past Duke of York Square
Ormonde Yard is the arch on the left after Smith Street
Get off at Chelsea Old Town Hall
Walk back along the King's Road to the yard
